name: No rugs: the staged room around an oak VALNÄS, a LAUTERS between the POÄNG and the sofa, the GREJSIMOJS mat by the toy wall
notes:
Rug-free alternative (F-66): the staged arrangement (a) with no textile rug, for a family that may skip rugs for dust and dust mites. No TV (F-65); the bottom side is open to the kitchen and dining area, so its 30-inch walkway (y 143-173) stays clear (F-42): nothing stands against it or hangs on it, and it is the route from the stairs to the kitchen and dining room.
What replaced each rug: the TIOKRONA under the conversation group gives way to the group itself, pulled around an oak VALNÄS coffee table (an ellipse, no corners, no glass) and lit by a LAUTERS floor lamp in the corner between the POÄNG and the sofa. The LEN play rug gives way to the GREJSIMOJS mat (47 1/4" square, polyurethane-coated so it wipes down, hand-wash per its page), laid open by the toy wall; it folds up into a toy box, and a VARPTROSS wall lamp over the BESTÅ lights the play corner the LEN marked.
F-66 moves: (1) the group around one anchor, the VALNÄS, 16" from the sofa and 16" from the POÄNG; (2) light marking each zone: for the group, the LAUTERS in the corner between the POÄNG and the sofa (their reading light) and the STORSEGEL lamps on the side table and the console; for the play area, the VARPTROSS over the BESTÅ and the UPPLYST over the reading bench; (3) wall anchors on the play wall the POÄNG faces, both off the heater wall: the PJÄTTERYD Waterlilies over the TROFAST (27 1/2" over its 36 5/8", three quarters of it) and the RÖDALM over the BESTÅ beside the FLISAT books; the sofa floats, so the window it faces, with the curtains hung wide, is its view; (4) one palette in washable textiles: beige (the GINSTMOTT curtains, the KIVIK's washable cover, the GREJSIMOJS), off-white (two SVARTPOPPEL covers, the VALLKRASSING throw) and sage (three VALLKRASSING gray-green covers, on the sofa and the POÄNG, repeated in the FEJKA's and the Waterlilies' greens); (5) the FEJKA bird of paradise at the console's end (artificial: wipe its leaves); (6) the GREJSIMOJS in the play area. The LÖVA canopy over the reading bench is left out: it gathers dust and washes only by hand.
sofa-1 KIVIK, rot 180, x 80.125-169.875, y 85-122.375, facing the window: its front 79" from the heater face (F-33, 12" needed); the console and then the 30" open-side walkway behind it (F-39: 35.3" behind the console); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
console-1 LACK console, x 97.438-152.562, y 122.375-137.75, against the sofa's back, facing the dining side: lamp-2 STORSEGEL on top, three GNABBAS baskets on its shelf; 5.3" short of the walkway (F-42); plant-1 FEJKA at its left end (x 86-95, y 126-135).
coffee-table-1 VALNÄS, oak veneer, 46 1/2 x 28 3/8", centered on the sofa, x 101.75-148.25, y 40.625-69: 16" from the sofa (F-39); 34.6" between it and the heater face at its widest point, the route along the window (F-30), wider toward its rounded ends. It replaces the LACK: about half the sofa's length, where the LACK was two fifths.
chair-1 POÄNG facing east at the table's left end, x 53.5-85.75, y 44.812-71.562: 16" from the table, 38.8" from the heater face (F-33), 17.5" off the strip along the railing; floor-lamp-1 LAUTERS beside it (below).
side-table-1 LACK side table with lamp-1 STORSEGEL at the sofa's left arm, x 58.5-80.125, y 95.562-117.188.
floor-lamp-1 LAUTERS (24" base, 59" tall at full height), x 53.5-77.5, y 71.562-95.562, in the corner between the POÄNG's right arm and the sofa's left arm: the reading light for both seats, matching the two ash-and-white STORSEGEL; 17.5" off the strip along the railing and out of every route. It replaces the TÅGARP (black metal, a 3' 3" cord), and it no longer stands between the sofa and the LÄTT.
toy-bench-1 SMÅSTAD, right-upper wall x 240.5-261, y 18-53.375: the reading seat in the window corner, 12" from the heater face (F-33: a cushion needs 12"); its boxes keep 24" clear in front (F-32). wall-lamp-1 UPPLYST above it; no canopy in this variant. Check the heater's surface temperature before she reads there.
toy-storage-1 TROFAST, right-upper wall x 243.625-261, y 56.375-93: bins at her height, 24" clear in front (F-32); 20 1/2" tall, no anchoring needed.
toy-cabinet-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors 47 1/4 x 16 1/2 x 15", standing on the floor against the right-lower wall, x 259-275.5, y 94.75-142 (F-63): solid Lappviken push-open doors at her height, no glass, 15" tall (no anchoring needed); 24" clear in front (F-32); 1" short of the open side's walkway (F-42). book-display-1 FLISAT stands on its end by the step (top layer) with her picture books, wall-lamp-2 VARPTROSS above it (center about 66" up, out of her reach from the floor, its cord in a cover down behind the cabinet), and art-2 RÖDALM on the wall above its lower half.
play-mat-1 GREJSIMOJS, open, rug layer, x 192-239.25, y 50-97.25: in front of the TROFAST and the SMÅSTAD, clear of the bench's footprint, 44" from the heater face.
kids-table-1 LÄTT with its two chairs, x 200-224.75, y 108-126.875, below the mat: 30.1" from the sofa's right arm, the way from the dining side onto the play floor (F-30), and 34.25" from the BESTÅ; outside the TROFAST's and the BESTÅ's 24" (F-32), its upper chair at the mat's edge, its lower chair 5" above the walkway (F-42).
art-1 PJÄTTERYD Waterlilies on the right-upper wall over the TROFAST (y 60.938-88.438); art-2 RÖDALM on the right-lower wall over the BESTÅ (y 118-137.75); wall-lamp-2 VARPTROSS over the FLISAT (y 102.125-109.125).
Right side (F-61): the right-lower wall carries the BESTÅ (47 1/4" of the 50" left of the walkway), the 93" right-upper wall the SMÅSTAD and the TROFAST.
Not placed: the TV and every TV unit (F-65); the TIOKRONA and LEN rugs (F-66); the LACK coffee table (the VALNÄS replaces it); the TÅGARP (the LAUTERS replaces it); the LILJETRÄD mirror (glass, F-21); the LÖVA canopy (above); as in a, the 70 7/8" BESTÅ drawer combination, the BISSA shoe cabinet, hooks and PERJOHAN bench, the chaise sofa, the KALLAX units, the KIVIK ottoman and STOENSE rug, the VALLABY rug and the kid's POÄNG.
Stairs: they run outside the left wall, beyond the measured 261" (F-40; Andrew, 2026-10-24: the stairs add to the room, they are not cut from it), so the floor is whole up to that wall. The stair side is a railing (Andrew, 2026-10-24), so the 36" strip along it (x 0-36) stays clear its whole length, landings included (y 0-36 and y 137-173): it is the walkway between the stairs' two ends, and nothing Maddie can climb stands at the railing (F-40, F-21). The bottom landing opens onto the open side's walkway, the top one onto the strip and the route along the window (F-30). Which end people step off is unknown (assumed-position:stairs).
Heater: every clearance is measured from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces start at y 12 or more and upholstery at y 18 or more (F-33). Window: its place on the top wall is eyeballed (assumed-position:window); curtains and rod hang there and nothing stands under it (F-38).
Entry: the old shoe cabinet, hooks and mirror hung on the bottom wall, which is open, so they are gone; the console behind the sofa is the drop zone. The LILJETRÄD mirror that moved to the window wall above the top landing is off the plan too: it is glass (F-21).
Kid safety (F-21): no glass anywhere; no storage over 27"; the VALNÄS has no corners at her height; no floor lamp stands in the play area.
Power: the stair side is a railing and the bottom side is open, so outlets can only be on the window wall and the play wall, and where they are is not recorded. The UPPLYST and VARPTROSS cords run down the play wall in cord covers. The LAUTERS (11' 6" cord) and the two STORSEGEL need flat floor cord covers to the window wall, crossing the route along the window well east of the top landing, never across the strip along the railing or the open side's walkway. With no rug every floor cord shows; a cordless lamp on the console would save one run.
Extras: GINSTMOTT curtains x2 pairs, HUGAD rod x1 (no-dimensions, an extra), SVARTPOPPEL covers x2, VALLKRASSING covers x3 (two on the sofa, one on the POÄNG), FJÄDRAR inserts x5, VALLKRASSING throw x1, GNABBAS baskets x3 (console shelf).
Audit 2026-10-24: the LILJETRÄD mirror is off the plan, because it is glass and F-21 allows none. The LAUTERS stood 1" from the sofa's right arm and 5" from the LÄTT, closing the way from the dining side onto the play floor (F-30), with its tripod where Maddie runs around her table and its cord across the play floor: it moved to the corner between the POÄNG and the sofa as their reading light, in place of the black TÅGARP, and the side table moved 3.6" toward the open side to make room. The way between the sofa and the LÄTT is 30.1" again. A VARPTROSS wall lamp, the dining room's bamboo sconce, lights the play corner the LEN marked. These notes now record the railing (F-40) and the lamp cords. Every textile left washes in a machine except the POÄNG's cushion (vacuum and wipe only) and the GREJSIMOJS (hand wash).
